name: Translation and Proofreading
description: English text is checked for spelling and grammar, German text is translated into English and English into German, on this computer only. In the inspector (its own tab) or in a window of its own: the text goes in, the result comes out with every change marked, live while you type; a click on a word keeps the original or offers other words, a double click shows its spelling suggestions and words of a similar meaning. A single word gets what it means (English words: WordNet; German words: an optional dictionary download), its word classes and its suggestions. Swap turns the direction around, Translate back shows what the translation says. Dialogue keeps its quotation marks as written. Rules: no em-dashes, American spelling, curly quotes, three periods instead of the ellipsis character, and your own replacements. The models are chosen and downloaded once under File > Options > Proofreading (CoEdIT, Qwen3 1.7B and 4B, OPUS-MT), checked, and then used without any connection; models too large for the computer are not offered. Engine: CTranslate2 with oneDNN and SentencePiece. Brings Qt's TLS plugin for the download.
author: Quillbinder
whatsNew: A single word is looked up first: English words show what they mean (WordNet), German words use an optional dictionary download (Wiktionary extract, CC BY-SA 4.0) with word classes and English words per meaning
New buttons Swap and Translate back, and English to German with a small model (OPUS-MT English to German, downloaded on request)
Single words and texts of up to three words never go to the large translation model; in translate mode the second row shows the translation model
The word pane no longer lists the model's other words; other translations of a short text are complete translations without invented names
